m1_frozen_design.lineage: E-consistent per-column (experimental prototype; not adoptable for the manuscript)

seeds.rule: split = base + r; thin = base + 10 r + regime_index; model = base + r (shared by all four fits of replicate r)

m1_frozen_design.primary: Procrustes RMSE_Z (rotation only); delta_RMSE_Z = wrong - correct
secondary: held-out Bernoulli plug-in mean log score (run_heldout_k_selection_pilot.heldout_bernoulli_mean_log_score)
m1_frozen_design.x_metric: not computed (no cross-family raw likelihood ranking)
m1_frozen_design.success_criterion: none on the sign of delta; any direction is a valid result

part_b_limitation: model seed drives initial values AND Monte Carlo draws; A vs B measures their joint run-to-run variation, not MC error alone

estimators.mean5: mean of the L=5 final E-step samples
estimators.mode: joint mode of ln p(X, Y_train | Z, theta_hat) + ln p(Z) by laplace_k_criterion, Z0 = last, grad_tol 1e-08, max_iter 200

mode_local_solution_diagnostic: second mode from Z0 = mean5 (not used in the primary)
mode_non_ok_policy: NOT_STATIONARY / HESSIAN_NOT_PD recorded, never imputed; primary uses complete pairs (both arms OK in that regime); completion counts reported separately
primary: Part A, mode, paired delta RMSE_Z (wrong - correct) per regime and interaction

reproduction_rule.rule: REPRODUCED if every metric of every Part A fit is within 1e-12 of M1; REPRODUCED_WITH_FP_DIFFERENCE if within 1e-6 and no paired delta changes sign (investigate and record, continue); otherwise NOT_REPRODUCED: Part B and the comparison are not run
